captions: Then Rune spots a download of the studio's own cost sheet in the log.
The download follows a file name wherever it leads, even out of the proofs folder.
You catch the escape, keep downloads in the folder and write the test, in three tasks.
Now a download gives a proof from the proofs folder, or nothing at all.
Same links, same disk. Staff files stay with the staff.
